title: Spec of a ring map is unramified iff the ring map is of finite type with vanishing differentials
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the induced morphism of affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi$ is unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism] if and only if $\varphi$ is an unramified ring map in the sense of Stacks, Algebra, Definition 00UT: $S$ is a finitely generated $R$-algebra (via $\varphi$) and the module of Kähler differentials $\Omega_{S/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is zero.
